name: Pokehike (Pokemon Crystal port for round-screen ESP32)

mentions.name: Pokehike (Pokemon Crystal port for round-screen ESP32)
mentions.description: This is a Pokemon themed tamagotchi-style game with step counting that evolved into a full Rust port of Pokemon Crystal running on an ESP32 dev board with a round AMOLED screen. It features a redesigned UI built for round displays with touch controls, Bluetooth and WiFi trading, autosave, contextual action buttons, and an experimental auto-play mode that advances the game while the player walks in real life, letting them take over at any time while logging interesting events along the way.
mentions.problem: Wanted motivation to walk more, using a step-counting game to encourage walking.
mentions.audience: Personal use: a tamagotchi-style game intended to motivate the author to walk more
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a port of Pokemon Crystal for a specific ESP32 dev board with a round amoled screen.
mentions.author: AurelioB
